Esthwaite Water buoy monitoring data (2008–2011)

Esthwaite_Buoy_OLD.Rd

Data from an automatic water monitoring buoy at Esthwaite Water, England, collected between 2008 and 2011.

The dataset contains high-frequency measurements of water temperature at multiple depths, alongside meteorological variables.

This dataset consists of hourly lake temperature, air temperature, solar irradiance and wind speed data from an automatic water monitoring buoy on Esthwaite Water, a lake in north-west England. Lake temperatures were measured at multiple depths (see supporting documentation). Measurements were taken every 4 minutes and aggregated to hourly averages. The data were collected by the Centre for Ecology & Hydrology between 2008 and 2011.

Usage

Esthwaite_Buoy_OLD

Format

A data frame with 35,064 rows and 16 variables:

Date_GMT

Date and time of observation (POSIXct)

Water_temperature_0.5m

Water temperature at 0.5 m depth (degrees C)

Water_temperature_1m

Water temperature at 1 m depth (degrees C)

Water_temperature_2m

Water temperature at 2 m depth (degrees C)

Water_temperature_3m

Water temperature at 3 m depth (degrees C)

Water_temperature_4m

Water temperature at 4 m depth (degrees C)

Water_temperature_5m

Water temperature at 5 m depth (degrees C)

Water_temperature_6m

Water temperature at 6 m depth (degrees C)

Water_temperature_7m

Water temperature at 7 m depth (degrees C)

Water_temperature_8m

Water temperature at 8 m depth (degrees C)

Water_temperature_9m

Water temperature at 9 m depth (degrees C)

Water_temperature_10m

Water temperature at 10 m depth (degrees C)

Water_temperature_11m

Water temperature at 11 m depth (degrees C)

Air_Temperature

Air temperature (degrees C)

Pyranometer

Incoming solar radiation

Wind_Speed

Wind speed

Source

https://doi.org/10.5285/94abcb39-84a6-428e-a90f-156452197d79

References

Jones, I., & Feuchtmayr, H. (2017). Data from automatic water monitoring buoy from Esthwaite Water, 2008 to 2011. NERC Environmental Information Data Centre. doi:10.5285/94abcb39-84a6-428e-a90f-156452197d79
